lines.beaver: 안녕하세요, 김민수 씨. 검진 결과 보러 오셨죠?
lines.beaver_en: Hello, Mr. Kim Minsu. You're here for your checkup results, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Annyeonghaseyo, Gim Minsu ssi. Geomjin gyeolgwa boreo osyeotjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 선생님. 혈압이 높다는 소리를 들어서 걱정돼요.
lines.en: Yes, doctor. I was told my blood pressure is high, so I'm worried.
lines.roman: Ne, seonsaengnim. Hyeorabi nopdaneun sorireul deureoseo geokjeongdwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 혈압은 정상입니다. 혈액 순환은 좋은 편입니다.
lines.beaver_en: Your blood pressure is normal. Your blood circulation is fairly good.
lines.beaver_roman: Hyeorabeun jeongsangimnida. Hyeoraek sunhwaneun joeun pyeonimnida.
lines.en: What a relief. Maybe it's because I quit smoking.
Last year. I was told my lungs were getting worse.

lines.beaver: 폐와 호흡기는 깨끗합니다. 숨을 크게 내쉬어 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Your lungs and respiratory organs are clear. Breathe out deeply.
lines.beaver_roman: Pyewa hoheupgineun kkaekkeutamnida. Sumeul keuge naeswieo boseyo.
lines.en: Phew, like this? My shoulders feel a bit stiff.

lines.beaver: 몸이 굳어 있네요. 편하게 앉아 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Your body is tense. Try sitting comfortably.
lines.beaver_roman: Momi gudeo inneyo. Pyeonhage anja boseyo.
lines.learner: 아, 제가 몸이 좀 뻣뻣한 편이라서요.
lines.en: Oh, my body tends to be a bit stiff.
lines.roman: A, jega momi jom ppeotppeotan pyeoniraseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Try stretching. Is your digestion okay?
lines.learner: 장이 약한 체질이라 배가 자주 아파요.
lines.en: My intestines are naturally weak, so my stomach often hurts.
lines.roman: Jangi yakan chejirira baega jaju apayo.

lines.beaver: 내시경 결과, 장에 큰 문제는 없었습니다.
lines.beaver_en: The endoscopy showed no big problems in your intestines.
lines.beaver_roman: Naesigyeong gyeolgwa, jange keun munjeneun eopseotseumnida.
lines.en: Both my large and small intestines are fine? That's a relief.

lines.beaver: 네. 소변 검사에서는 피가 조금 보였습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes. But the urine test showed a little blood.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne. Sobyeon geomsaeseoneun piga jogeum boyeotseumnida.
lines.learner: 소변 볼 때 옆구리가 가끔 아팠어요.
lines.en: My side sometimes hurt when I urinated.
lines.roman: Sobyeon bol ttae yeopguriga gakkeum apasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 신장 검사를 더 해 봅시다. 치아는 어떠세요?
lines.beaver_en: Let's do more kidney tests. How are your teeth?
lines.beaver_roman: Sinjang geomsareul deo hae bopsida. Chianeun eotteoseyo?
lines.en: My gums bleed. Could it be from aging?

lines.beaver: 치과 진료도 받으세요. 다음 달에 다시 뵙겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Please see a dentist too. I'll see you again next month.
lines.beaver_roman: Chigwa jillyodo badeuseyo. Daeum dare dasi boepgetseumnida.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll take better care of my health.
